description: Image insertion by file drop recorded in s1: drop the self-generated 64x48 fixture at viewport (1000,200) and read the scene (06b-image-drop, io-04-image-drop). Requires the end state of 06 (scroll 90,45) and fixtures/test-64x48.png. From s6 on, its emulate step is an assertMetrics step and only 00 emulates. In s5 the re-applied override read back the headless default screen (800x600) because the preceding Playwright screenshot had reset the emulated screen metrics; that was later reproduced on a self-authored fixture, and the driver now captures through CDP instead.
